HEADER: Init +9; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +17
DEFENSE: AC 20, touch 14; flat-footed 15 (+5 dex, +6 natural, -1 size)
OFFENSE: Melee 2 Claws +22 (2d6+8 plus grab), Bite +21 (2d6+8 plus grab)
Special Attacks Blaster, Hyper Blaster, Pounce, Rake (2 Claws +22, 2d6+8)
2nd (DC 15) - blizzard II, poison, silence, thunder II
3rd (DC 16) - bio, blizzara, blizzard III, lightning bolt, thundara, thunder III
STATISTICS: Str 26, Dex 20, Con 18, Int 17, Wis 14, Cha 8
Base Atk +14; CMB +24 (+28 grapple); CMD 39 (43 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (Claw), Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Spell Penetration, Weapon Focus (Claw)
Skills Acrobatics +21, Perception +17, Stealth +18 (+22 in areas of tall grass), Swim +19; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Stealth (+8 in tall grass)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Blaster (su) A master coeurl can send out a pulse of electricity through its whiskers at a single target within 30 ft. The master coeurl must make a ranged touch attack (+18), if it hits, the target takes 3d6 points of lightning damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 16) or be inflicted with Immobilize status for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

Darting Claw (ex) Evolved for snatching fast prey, a master coeurl is exceptionally quick with its claws. When making a full attack, if a master coeurl misses with both of its claw attacks, it can make an additional claw attack at a -2 penalty against any creature within its reach.

Hyper Blaster (su) 3/day, a master coeurl can send out a pulse of extreme electricity through its whiskers at a single target within 30 ft. The master coeurl must make a ranged touch attack (+18), if it hits, the target takes 5d6 points of lightning damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 22) or be inflicted with Doom status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
Pounce (ex) A master coeurl can make a full attack (including its rake attack) when it makes a charge attack.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
